== Decklists table (2026-10-16) ==
=== Build notes ===
* Replaced the Trandosite bullet list with Date / Format / Title / Side / Event, the same columns as [[Trandosite decks]] minus Author.
* Format cells copy the dested 60s, including "(from the card pool)".
* Date is the event date when the 60 names one ([[2000 European Championship]] August 2000; [[2000 Naboo Regionals]] 4 June 2000). The Terror of Tatooine has no event; that date is the Trandosite hub capture year 2001.
* Search And Destroy is the modified Trandosite list from the Naboo Regional, so its format stays [[Premiere - Death Star II]] (from the card pool) with the 60, even though the 4 June 2000 regional was before Death Star II.
* [[Rod Latham Endor Uprising]] is Latham's list; it is off this table.
=== Missing data ===
* Dark Surgeon has no dested page; it stays in Star Wars CCG prose (UK National 3–0; Colorado in John Arendt's hands; GEMP P-RefII AOBS-Alex Tennet).
* 2000 European Championship and 2000 Naboo Regionals finishes.
